dict.string: Bubble uses Accessibility so double-tap Command can summon the chat panel from any app.
Bubble previews markdown files you click in the conversation, including files in Documents.
Bubble previews markdown files you click in the conversation, including files in Downloads.
Bubble previews markdown files you click in the conversation, including files on the Desktop.
Bubble captures your microphone together with system audio so Record notes include both sides of a meeting. Audio stays on this Mac.
Bubble transcribes Record audio on this Mac with Apple Speech. Audio is not sent off this computer.
Bubble captures system audio (not your screen) so Record can caption a video meeting playing on this Mac.
Bubble captures system audio so Record can caption a meeting playing on this Mac. Audio stays on this Mac.
